text_block_list.text: After a day out...
choice_data_list: This time I'll make sure you have fun!

text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Look, I didn't have any fun the last time you tried to play a game with me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Stop with the kiddy games. It's not
gonna happen.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Sure—last time ended in failure—but
today, I
have an ace up my sleeve. I
know all about the
game she's been
obsessed with recently.

RDLI is a PvP FPS developed overseas.
What
makes it fun is the wide arsenal of
weapons
players can use to outwit their
opponents.

I thought I was the only one around here
who
plays it...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I heard from Супер Крик that Narita
Taishin's
been grumbling about not
having anyone to play
with.

I stand little chance of beating an
experienced
player like her, but she'll
probably enjoy it if I put
up a good
enough fight.
Fine. I accept your challenge.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little unsettled by how readily she
accepts
my offer, but I charge into
battle nevertheless,
ready to give the
fight of my life.
YOU LOSE.

That's another win for me. I'm five for
five now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yeah? I mean, I do play a lot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you had a lot of nerve
challenging me
despite being trash at
the game.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You choose terrible weapons and stages,
and you
suck at using the NPCs. Did you
even change the
settings to match your
play style?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
This is my first time playing PvP mode,
so I was
looking forward to it, but
playing against you is
disappointing as
hell.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is rarely this chatty. She
seems to
be in a good mood now that
she's found someone
to wipe the floor
with.

It's no fun like this... Want me to make
things
easier for you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Wow, no hesitation. Don't you have any
pride?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I just want to keep hanging out with you.

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I keep losing so easily, she's going to
get bored.
I'll gladly throw away my
pride to give her a
better match.

Do you hear yourself? You are seriously
have no
shame at all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll only use the default weapons, and
you can
borrow one of my SSRs. If you
still can't win, then
you're a lost cause.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hmph, whatever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: YOU LOSE.
I knew you couldn't do it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Even after countless rematches, I just
can't win
against her. I try to apologize
for being a terrible
partner, but she cuts
me off.

It's fine. We can play again some other
time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The rewards they give out for winning
PvP
matches are pretty good. Plus,
crushing you is
kinda fun.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmm? You really think you can beat me
without
any boosts?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Then you should just ask for a handicap.
It'll even
the playing field.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
This game is super fun, so I want to try winning
by myself.

text_block_list.text:
I thought you were gonna complain
about being
bad at strategizing, not
getting the controls, or
that the game's
too violent and scary.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: If you say so. Give me your best.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be in an even better mood,
but...

text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Uh... What does this item do again?

text_block_list.text: Ugggh! Stop!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm getting ticked off just watching you
play! You
should use that item you got
earlier and...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
See? Now you get more health back.
Restoration
items are vital to winning.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I see now! You're incredible, Taishin!

text_block_list.text:
...This is, like, the most basic of basic
knowledge.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Whatever. Agh, look at the time! I've
wasted the
whole day with you!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Thanks for teaching me so much, Taishin!

text_block_list.text: I don't need your thanks! I'm leaving!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She leaves in a huff, but I'm glad I got to
play so
many rounds against her.

Her words are harsh, but at least she's
giving me a
chance.
